long_window_context: At least ten complete years; shorter-window passes are reported separately, never proof of annual reliability.
source_input_requirement: Separate owner-private QuantLab results; this repository does not contain the full underlying workspace.
limitations: Original data, accounting, selection and cost limitations carry forward unchanged.
Some leverage histories are synthetic, not attainable fund records.
Timing-study stocks are hindsight survivors, not a point-in-time universe.
Training prefixes and overlapping windows are not independent observations.
No original engine or input dataset is rerun; this audits archived annual rows.
